summary.headline: Astrological Questions on War and Omens
summary.text: Continuation of a catalogued astrological question list, covering treasure and place-finding, buried or walled objects, rank, war, siege, military deceit and movement, hope, omens in the sky, death dates, riding, slavery, business, partnership, tickets, migration, and founding towers or cities, with cross-references to Theophilus and several codices.
